build_reproducibility.acceptance: Normalized source-changing executable and library artifacts are byte-identical across two clean builds.

evidence_additions_before_runtime.public_randomness: The full post-freeze, three-relay-agreed receipt is preserved and verified with the hash-bound repository BLS verifier before schedule derivation.
evidence_additions_before_runtime.runtime_closure: Each arm hashes the executed binary and every executable file observed through /proc/PID/maps. Unmapped build intermediates are excluded and all 20 observed closures must match.
evidence_additions_before_runtime.systemd: The runner records Result, ExecMainCode, ExecMainStatus, MemoryPeak, and MemorySwapPeak before deliberate shutdown. The scorer requires success, clean live status, bounded peak memory, and zero swap peak.
evidence_additions_before_runtime.direct_descriptor_observation: The frozen three-shard model requires exactly three O_DIRECT model descriptors in ON and zero in OFF.

scope_limit: This revision changes only pre-runtime evidence validity and reproducible-build binding. It does not change the performance thresholds, model, serving semantics, profile, context, admission, or inference path.
